description: This file defines the CategoryEntity class, a Java class extending Category, representing a category entity in an e-commerce system with additional properties like sortOrder, visibility, code, and lineage.

classes.name: CategoryEntity
classes.description: A Java class extending Category, representing a category in the catalog with additional metadata such as sort order, visibility, code, and lineage.

methods.name: getSortOrder
methods.description: Returns the sort order of the category.

methods.name: setSortOrder
methods.description: Sets the sort order of the category.

methods.name: isVisible
methods.description: Returns whether the category is visible.

methods.name: setVisible
methods.description: Sets the visibility status of the category.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the code of the category.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the code of the category.

methods.name: getLineage
methods.description: Returns the lineage of the category.

methods.name: setLineage
methods.description: Sets the lineage of the category.
